addressed_findings: Removed production per-probe counters after the initial Q34 regression; that failed-performance screen is preserved.
Added scalar collision-chain cancellation and used-native-dictionary invalid UTF8 coverage before final build.
Corrected the test diagnostic to construct a consistent 24-GiB policy; the failed diagnostic and passing correction are both retained.

evidence_limits: Provider allocations outside HostAllocator and caller scan metadata are not a total-RSS bound.
The fixed task metadata allowance uses existing worker-pool accounting; not a byte-exact claim for every library allocation.
Test lookup counters cover find() probes, including credit rechecks, and exclude rehash/insertion searches.
The 32-bit packed entry case is source/fixture guarded; the measured and executed test target is macOS ARM64.
reviewed_contracts: Borrowed native UTF8 preserves all-value validation and independently owned retained rows.
Compact AVG/COUNT shape and typed dispatch preserve selected row order, measure order, floating additions and error partial state.
Scalar admission excludes predicates, grouping, spill and source-order limits; decline restores provider drivers before input.
Scalar chunk owners and task scratch stay reserved; partition replacement peaks are leased; globally duplicate keys do not copy persistent bytes.
Full hashes plus complete bytes resolve collisions; referenced dictionary codes/value nulls and malformed used UTF8 have fixtures.
Worker failure drains/cancels jobs before partition owners drop; collision probing observes cancellation.
Packed directory tags only reject; 48-bit ordinals and capacity are checked, empty sentinel preserved, actual entry width charged.
Vacancies are local to a locked update, invalidated on directory growth, and never published on allocation denial.
